name: MyNeS
description: MyNeS - My Network Scanner discovers, identifies and monitors every device on your home network, including the ones an IP scan cannot see. It speaks ARP, mDNS/Bonjour, SSDP/UPnP, Matter, Bluetooth LE and MQTT, so Zigbee2MQTT bulbs, Z-Wave JS sensors, BLE trackers and Tasmota nodes show up next to your laptops and NAS. Vendor lookup over a 1000+ entry OUI database, automatic device-type classification, topology and graph views, scan history, rule-based alerts by Web Push / webhook / e-mail, and two-way Home Assistant integration. No cloud, no account, no telemetry.
